title: Fourth of July food, drinks, and music planned by Park City restaurants - NewsBreak
text: PARK CITY, Utah — Independence Day in Park City promises to be as flavorful as it is festive, as members of the Park City Area Restaurant Association (PCARA) prepare to celebrate America’s birthday with a lineup of food specials, live entertainment, and exclusive events. From July 3 through the Fourth, restaurants across the area will offer holiday-themed menus and experiences, welcoming guests with everything from backyard cookout fare to mixology classes on scenic rooftops. Deer Valley Café will host AppAlaska Bluegrass for a series of live performances on its deck from July 3 to July 6, noon to 3 p.m. each day. The special holiday menu includes pulled pork sandwiches, smoked Niman Ranch brisket, cheeseburgers, bratwursts, and hot dogs. At Hyatt Centric Park City , Escala Provisions Company will serve a Burger & Beverage special, offering a double smash brisket burger with a side for $17.76. Guests can also cool down with 50% off Canyons Peach Lemonade all day long. Goldener Hirsch kicks off the celebrations early on July 3 with Aperitifs at Altitude: An Elevated Mixology Experience. Beginning at 4 p.m. on the rooftop pool deck, the hands-on class includes the creation of two signature cocktails, paired with sweeping mountain views. Advance registration is required by calling 435-655-2563. At Montage Deer Valley , the Fourth of July Cookout at Slope Stream restaurant will offer summer favorites from 2 to 5 p.m., ideal for families and groups looking to enjoy the afternoon outdoors. tupelo will mark both Independence Day and its own milestone with a special $10 for 10 Years Menu, featuring small plates, select wines, and an Old Fashioned cocktail—all priced at $10 each to celebrate the restaurant’s 10th anniversary. Some local favorites, including Blind Dog , Grub Steak , Handle , and Shabu , will be closed on July 4. Diners are encouraged to check operating hours in advance and plan accordingly. For a complete list of PCARA member restaurants, holiday specials, and additional details, visit www.parkcityrestaurants.com .
